_readme: Sign registry manifest (spec-05). Copy to signs.json, fill in, drop the SVG/PNG files into
Where the official assets come from: Statens vegvesen publishes the sign images alongside
skiltforskriften (vegvesen.no → skilt). Ask your contact there for the asset pack — the sign
designs are defined by regulation, so they are not someone's artwork to license, but you want
the authoritative files rather than redrawn approximations.
Wikimedia Commons was checked and is NOT a usable source: codes 100 (farlig sving), 202
(vikeplikt), 204 (stopp) and 302 (innkjøring forbudt) are absent entirely, and what exists is
skewed toward service and direction signs. A registry built from it would quiz students on the
signClass values: FARE, VIKEPLIKT_OG_FORKJORS, FORBUD, PABUD, OPPLYSNING, SERVICE,

meaning.en: You must give way to traffic on the crossing road.
meaning.nb: Du har vikeplikt for trafikken på kryssende veg.

meaning.en: You must stop completely before entering, then give way.
meaning.nb: Du må stanse helt før du kjører ut, og deretter vike.
